parse.title: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
====Pasty bones====
{{Checklist|*Go towards fairy ring {{Fairycode|CKR}} south of Tai Bwo Wannai, then run north to the fishing spots
*Fish 45 raw karambwanji. These are stackable, and will be needed for the rest of the quest
*Use your pestle and mortar on one of the raw karambwanji to get [[karambwanji paste]]
*Use the paste on the [[burnt jogre bones]] to get [[pasty jogre bones]]
*  *('''DO NOT BURY''')* Cook the pasty jogre bones to get [[marinated jogre bones]]}}
